# A 30.00 invoice on a receivable kept to a tenth of a cent, paid by naming a
# 50.00 transaction. The residual is 20.000 — the account's unit is a
# thousandth, so that is the figure it holds and reports — and that is what
# `prepayment:` has to state, so it is also what the message asking for it has
# to name.
invoice "INV-FINE-RETARGET"
	customer_id: "C-FINE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-FINE-RETARGET"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-05
		amount: 50.00
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		memo: "Overpayment"
PREPAY_LINE
